items.criterion: A box of three current-cycle editions places and the order carries the total 3997.
items.judgment: Build the box as the US member, place it, and read the total on the order.

items.criterion: A box holding no edition from the current cycle is refused at placement.
items.judgment: Place a box holding only a previous-cycle edition and read the refusal.

items.criterion: A fourth edition is refused and the box still holds three.
items.judgment: Add a fourth edition to a full box and re-read the box.

items.criterion: Every edition remains addable while the box is not yet valid.
items.judgment: Add a second ineligible edition to an invalid box and read the response.

items.criterion: A box link carrying four ids produces a box of three.
items.judgment: Open the box with four ids in the query and count the items.

items.criterion: A two-book US box totals 2898 and a three-book CA box totals 5797.
items.judgment: Read the running total on a two-book US box and on a three-book CA box.

items.criterion: An invoice for 39.97 USD exists in the billing platform after a three-book US order.
items.judgment: Place the order and read the invoice list from the billing platform.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous placements of one box leave exactly one order row.
items.judgment: Submit the same box twice at once and count the order rows.

items.criterion: A credit removes the base charge before any extra-book charge.
items.judgment: Place a three-book CA box with one credit and read the total.

items.criterion: A confirmation whose subject begins with the pinned prefix reaches the placing member alone.
items.judgment: Place a box and read the inbox of the placing member.

items.criterion: An anonymous call to the placement endpoint is denied and writes no order row.
items.judgment: Call the placement endpoint with no token and count the order rows.

items.criterion: The gift buyer is denied every read of what the recipient chose.
items.judgment: Ask for the recipient's box from the buyer's session.

items.criterion: A seeded gift code redeems once and the second attempt is refused.
items.judgment: Redeem the seeded code twice from one session.

items.criterion: The reprint and the original resolve to two edition rows sharing one work row.
items.judgment: Read both edition rows and compare their identifiers.

items.criterion: Each seeded edition exists exactly once after the app has started.
items.judgment: Count the edition rows for each seeded slug.
